title: Bid 2700018 - Air Conditioners (Window & In-Wall)
agency_path: City of New York > Citywide Administrative Services
description_text:
All Bids are submitted electronically using NYC PASSPort. To review the details (bid documents, pre-bid conference notices, etc.) of this solicitation and participate, you must have a PASSPort account. Please visit the PASSPort Public RFx Site (aka 'Procurement Navigator') at: https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public and use the 'keyword' search field to locate the solicitation for 'Air Conditioners (Window & In-Wall)'. You may also search using the EPIN 85727B0033. If you have any issues with PASSPort, please contact the PASSPort Helpdesk at: nyc.gov/mocshelp

Bid opening and Pre-Bid Conference will be held virtually via Microsoft TEAMS, please see links to register in PASSPort.
